categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Tiantie Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: vibration damping products mainly for rail transit infrastructure, including rubber vibration isolation pads and related components; and lithium chemical products for new energy applications, including lithium salts and organolithium compounds. The company also extends into building seismic isolation products and other chemical materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary rubber formulation and manufacturing technologies for vibration damping products, including automated weighing, mixing, and vulcanization processes. In lithium chemicals, it employs advanced continuous production technologies such as catalyst-free continuous chlorinated alkane production, low-temperature negative pressure reactions for organolithium, and DBT crystallization for anhydrous lithium chloride. It also integrates intelligent monitoring and control systems for production optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese rail transit construction and maintenance entities such as China Railway and China Railway Construction subsidiaries, urban rail transit operators, and lithium chemical users in new energy, pharmaceuticals, and specialty materials sectors. The company serves domestic infrastructure projects extensively and supplies lithium chemical products to new energy battery manufacturers and chemical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major facilities in Zhejiang Province and subsidiaries across multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Anhui, Xinjiang, and Tibet. It has limited overseas sales and exports but mainly focuses on the domestic market, especially in economically developed and urbanized regions with dense rail transit networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Tiantie operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures finished vibration damping products for rail infrastructure and processes lithium chemical products from raw materials. The company is expanding upstream integration by developing lithium metal production capabilities and resource recycling technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in rail transit vibration damping and lithium chemical production. R&D focuses include developing new damping materials, intelligent monitoring systems, advanced lithium refining and purification processes, and expanding into building seismic isolation products. It also emphasizes digital transformation, automation, and sustainability in production processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products, including rubber vibration damping components and lithium chemical products. The company also earns income from related services, government subsidies, and investment returns. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's rail transit vibration damping market with advanced proprietary technologies and extensive application cases. In lithium chemicals, it competes with large integrated enterprises that control upstream lithium resources. The company differentiates through innovation, quality, and comprehensive service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.14 billion, a 41.7% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.2 million, reversing prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 5.77 billion, growing 9.5%. The company shows a positive growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and ongoing investment in new projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Tiantie emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced vibration damping products with superior noise and vibration reduction performance, tailored for complex rail transit environments. Its lithium chemical products feature high purity and stable quality, supported by continuous innovation and integrated production processes. The company offers comprehensive lifecycle services and maintains strong customer relationships, ensuring reliability and customized solutions.
